mapper.select: SELECT ij.journal_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.editable_until_at, COUNT(jtn.journal_trade_note_id) AS trade_note_count FROM investment_journals ij LEFT JOIN journal_trade_notes jtn ON jtn.journal_id = ij.journal_id WHERE ij.user_id = #{userId} AND ij.journal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ij.journal_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.editable_until_at ORDER BY ij.journal_date DESC
